decision: Determine whether model scale is the binding constraint, or whether the task/data/metric contract prevents stronger models from clearing semantic thresholds.

A_tiny_baseline.model: repo tiny TwoTower scratch baseline (e714 recipe, 600 steps, symbol-only output contract v2)
A_tiny_baseline.checkpoint: trained fresh under the run cap from outputs/data/train/slm230_symbol_only_v1; claim_class=diagnostic (scratch, not a ship candidate)

B_smollm2_135m.revision: pinned at execution time and recorded per arm
B_smollm2_135m.decode: greedy (temperature 0), max_new_tokens 384, prompt template published in the run manifest; official parser post-validation (legality measured, not enforced)

C_qwen25_7b.revision: pinned at execution time and recorded per arm
C_qwen25_7b.decode: identical template and decoding parameters as arm B

frozen_requests.source: outputs/data/test built from src/slm_training/resources/rico/semantic_test.jsonl via scripts/build_test_data (leakage-filtered vs train manifests)
frozen_requests.sha256: recorded at freeze time in the run manifest

metrics.primary: binding_aware_meaningful_v2_rate_strict (candidate_pending_calibration; deterministic fail-closed, no LLM judge)
secondary: meaningful_program_v1_report verdict rate + typed reason-code histogram (diagnostic-only per SLM-288 demotion)
metrics.human_subset: the SLM-288 frozen packet is output-labels of prior generations and does not transfer to new arm outputs; the three smoke prompts it covers are included in analysis as a secondary stratum with agent-rater labels relabeled blind per arm output (disclosed non-human)

thresholds.scale_binding: arm C primary-metric Wilson lower bound exceeds arm A Wilson upper bound by >= 0.10 AND arm C syntax/validity >= arm A
thresholds.task_or_metric_binding: arm C primary-metric Wilson upper bound <= 0.10 (even a 7B external model cannot clear semantic thresholds) OR arm C Wilson upper bound <= arm A Wilson lower bound + 0.10 (no scale effect)
thresholds.inconclusive: any other outcome, any arm incomplete (e.g. 7B infeasible under the run policy), or any evidence-bar violation

cost_cap.chunked_resume: arms run in <=170s chunks with deterministic resume; a timed-out or killed chunk is never evidence

claim_rules.leakage: prompts contain prompt-visible inputs only; no gold openui, placeholders inventory, or evaluator fields in prompts (checked by a prompt-audit test)
claim_rules.evidence: raw outputs persisted per arm + EvidenceBundleV1 (SLM-291) before disposition; AgentEvals JSONL + AgentV bundle (claim diagnostic)

lar_consequences.scale_binding: LAR2-LAR4 architecture program preserved; scale is the binding lever
lar_consequences.task_or_metric_binding: LAR2-LAR4 architecture program closes; task/data/metric contract must change first
lar_consequences.inconclusive: LAR2-LAR4 remain blocked pending the named resolving evidence
